mtls_enforced.title: Mutual TLS Enforced on Pipeline-to-API Channel
mtls_enforced.description: Whether the Kubernetes API server requires a valid client certificate from the CI/CD pipeline engine for all inbound connections (mTLS enforced, not merely server-side TLS). Also covers mutual TLS enforcement from any proxy to the API server.

client_certificate_validation_mode.title: Client Certificate Validation Mode
client_certificate_validation_mode.description: The mode in which the API server validates client certificates for the CI/CD pipeline connection: 'required' (mTLS enforced), 'optional' (cert accepted but not required), or 'none' (no client cert checked).

certificate_pinning_enabled.title: Certificate Pinning Enabled for Pipeline Client
certificate_pinning_enabled.description: Whether the pipeline engine pins the API server's certificate or CA, preventing trust in any certificate signed by an alternate CA or a fraudulent certificate from a redirected endpoint.

tls_certificate_validation_enforced.title: TLS Certificate Validation Enforced
tls_certificate_validation_enforced.description: Indicates whether the pipeline engine strictly validates the Kubernetes API server's certificate chain, hostname, and expiry when establishing the deployment channel.

self_signed_certificate_pinning_configur.title: Self-Signed Certificate Pinning Configured
self_signed_certificate_pinning_configur.description: Indicates whether certificate pinning is configured when self-signed or private CA certificates are used for the Kubernetes API server.

api_server_certificate_issuer_type.title: API Server Certificate Issuer Type
api_server_certificate_issuer_type.description: Classifies the type of certificate authority issuing the Kubernetes API server TLS certificate used on the deployment channel.

minimum_tls_version.title: Minimum TLS Version
minimum_tls_version.description: The minimum TLS protocol version enforced on the pipeline-to-API-server channel.

enabled_cipher_suites.title: Enabled Cipher Suites
enabled_cipher_suites.description: List of cipher suites enabled on the pipeline-to-API-server TLS channel.

weak_cipher_suites_explicitly_restricted.title: Weak Cipher Suites Explicitly Restricted
weak_cipher_suites_explicitly_restricted.description: Whether the configuration explicitly restricts or denies non-AEAD, export-grade, and RC4 cipher suites rather than relying on defaults.

replay_protection_mechanism.title: Replay Protection Mechanism
replay_protection_mechanism.description: Indicates whether the API channel enforces replay protection via nonces, timestamps, or sequence numbers on deployment requests.

deployment_token_max_ttl_seconds.title: Deployment Token Maximum TTL (Seconds)
deployment_token_max_ttl_seconds.description: Maximum lifetime in seconds of the authentication token or credential used to submit deployment requests to the Kubernetes API server. Short TTLs limit replay windows.

admission_webhook_replay_validation_enab.title: Admission Webhook Replay Validation Enabled
admission_webhook_replay_validation_enab.description: Whether a validating admission webhook or policy engine is configured to reject duplicate or replayed deployment requests based on a unique request identifier or manifest digest.

tls_termination_at_proxy_without_reencry.title: TLS Termination at Proxy Without Re-Encryption
tls_termination_at_proxy_without_reencry.description: Indicates whether an intermediate proxy terminates TLS from the CI/CD pipeline engine but forwards traffic to the Kubernetes API server in plaintext or with weaker encryption, exposing bearer tokens in transit.

bearer_token_in_url_query_params.title: Bearer Token Passed as URL Query Parameter
bearer_token_in_url_query_params.description: Indicates whether the CI/CD pipeline engine passes bearer tokens or service account JWTs as URL query parameters rather than Authorization headers, making tokens visible in logs.

manifest_payload_signing_enabled.title: Manifest Payload Signing Enabled
manifest_payload_signing_enabled.description: Whether deployment manifests are cryptographically signed at the application layer (e.g., via Sigstore/cosign attestations, HMAC) before transmission to the Kubernetes API server, independent of TLS transport security.

tls_inspection_or_proxy_present.title: TLS-Inspecting Proxy or Intermediary Present
tls_inspection_or_proxy_present.description: Whether a TLS-terminating proxy, load balancer, or network inspection device sits in the data path between the CI/CD pipeline engine and the Kubernetes API server and can decrypt, inspect, and re-encrypt traffic.

admission_controller_attestation_validat.title: Admission Controller Validates Manifest Attestations
admission_controller_attestation_validat.description: Whether a Kubernetes admission controller (e.g., Kyverno, OPA/Gatekeeper, Sigstore policy-controller) is configured to reject manifests that lack valid application-layer signatures or attestations.

api_server_rate_limiting_enabled.title: API Server Rate Limiting Enabled
api_server_rate_limiting_enabled.description: Whether request rate limiting is enforced on the Kubernetes API server for incoming deployment requests from the CI/CD pipeline channel (e.g., via --max-requests-inflight, --max-mutating-requests-inflight, or an admission webhook/API gateway throttle policy).

pipeline_service_account_quota_enforced.title: Pipeline Service Account Deployment Quota Enforced
pipeline_service_account_quota_enforced.description: Whether a ResourceQuota or LimitRange policy scoped to the pipeline service account or its namespace restricts the number of concurrent or total deployments it can create.

insecure_port_enabled.title: Kubernetes Insecure Port Enabled
insecure_port_enabled.description: Whether the Kubernetes API server has the insecure-port (--insecure-port) binding enabled, allowing unauthenticated HTTP traffic.

api_server_scheme.title: API Server Connection Scheme
api_server_scheme.description: The URL scheme used by the pipeline engine when connecting to the Kubernetes API server endpoint. Also covers whether TLS is enforced exclusively with no plaintext HTTP fallback.

tls_skip_verify_enabled.title: TLS Certificate Verification Skipped
tls_skip_verify_enabled.description: Whether the pipeline engine is configured to skip TLS certificate verification when connecting to the Kubernetes API server, undermining transport security even when HTTPS is used.

dnssec_validation_enforced.title: DNSSEC Validation Enforced
dnssec_validation_enforced.description: Whether the network resolver used by the pipeline engine enforces DNSSEC validation for API server hostname resolution, preventing DNS poisoning attacks.

api_server_endpoint_type.title: API Server Endpoint Resolution Type
api_server_endpoint_type.description: How the pipeline engine resolves and addresses the API server: via DNS hostname, hardcoded IP address, or service mesh sidecar (which may provide independent certificate validation).

certificate_revocation_mode.title: Certificate Revocation Checking Mode
certificate_revocation_mode.description: The revocation checking mode configured for the pipeline-to-API-server TLS connection, covering OCSP, CRL, both, or none.

api_gateway_payload_limit_enforced.title: API Gateway Payload Size Limit Enforced
api_gateway_payload_limit_enforced.description: Whether a maximum payload size limit is explicitly configured and active on the API gateway or load balancer in front of the Kubernetes API server for the CI/CD pipeline path.

admission_webhook_manifest_size_validati.title: Admission Webhook Manifest Size Validation Enabled
admission_webhook_manifest_size_validati.description: Whether a validating admission webhook (e.g., OPA Gatekeeper, Kyverno policy) is configured to reject manifests exceeding a defined size threshold before API server processing.
